purpose: Expand the surviving physical modality branch across independent public specimen records without post-hoc semantic search.

frozen_before_measurement.field: 0.40 luminance + 0.40 chromaticity + 0.20 normalized edge absolute difference
frozen_before_measurement.planner_status: FractalGPT may generate blinded trajectories only; it cannot define the field or admission threshold after seeing outcomes.

observational_metadata.FMDB_136: Quartz fluorescence is reported strongest under SW UV, dimmer under MW UV, with a broad emission near 610 nm likely activated by manganese and a UV peak around 350 nm.
observational_metadata.FMDB_393: Quartz is reported yellow fluorescent under LW/MW/SW while calcite is red under SW; this is a useful mixed-mineral control.
observational_metadata.FMDB_862: Quartz is reported green under SW with no reported MW/LW response; dull blue regions are described as unknown.
observational_metadata.FMDB_670: Quartz is reported white under SW UV.
observational_metadata.FMDB_1225: Petroleum inclusions in quartz are reported blue under both LW365 and SW254.

admission_rules.source_mapping: Only image-own alt/title labels may resolve a requested modality. Neighboring page text is diagnostic only.
admission_rules.same_specimen: A record-level assertion that multiple views belong to one specimen is required before calling a pair same-specimen.
admission_rules.independence: A second wavelength view of an already-used specimen cannot count as an independent specimen replication.
admission_rules.semantic_claims: No semantic claim can be admitted from image-level pattern statistics.
admission_rules.failure: Any source-resolution or registration integrity failure invalidates that run rather than being treated as a scientific negative or positive.

claim_ceiling: This manifest is a preregistered source corpus. It contains no new image-level measurement result and therefore supports no new scientific claim by itself.
